title: I'm great at getting the concept out of my head and represented with concept art, but awful at executing it.
author: Ruskarr
selftext:
I have a strong number of references I've been able to untangle from the idea I have in my head for a project, but when it comes to putting any of it together to have a playable scene or demo, it's miles and miles off of what I'd hoped for.

Ive tried using both openai and Claude to work on the prompts I'd need to get over the line but even then the results fall short. 

Can anyone offer any advice in this regard? I'm so eager to get going and have access to both Claude max subs and the equivalent gpt subs.

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body:
Specify miles and miles off. Is it grafics, gameloop, missing fun, missing functionality, etc.

Analyse what exactly is off by how much and break everything down, then you know what you can focus on instead of this "I don't get it I don't know someone help"

replies.author: Ruskarr
replies.body: You're right, I've added some context to the post. In short, systems are easily implemented, but building what I conceptualized visually is the major issue I'm walling against.

replies.author: Livid_Shallot5701
replies.body:
You are no artist? Then welcome to a world of pain. The most difficult part for nearly everyone is aesthetics. 

Do not think ai can solve this for you yet. It needs another 1 2 years for really good game art. So either reduce the artstyle to what you+ai can handle, hire an artist or produce ai slop

replies.author: theEsel01
replies.body: Its funny how AI is always needing one or two more years isn't it xD

comments.author: meshifthenelse
comments.body: Welcome to the 99.99% who don't succeed

comments.author: Cupheadvania
comments.body: give me one specific piece of art you have and one goal you are trying to achieve and what’s going wrong, and i’ll help you out.

replies.author: Ruskarr
replies.body: It seems the consensus is likely that the art and animation hiccups I'm facing at where most people find their projects going wrong.

comments.author: ConsiderationTall697
comments.body: Please spare me your life story

replies.author: Ruskarr
replies.body: Reddit typically does, unless you choose to engage with a post, that's more of a you problem don't you think?

replies.author: ConsiderationTall697
replies.body: Only thing in life yiu can get back is time and your post had only one sentence of actual info

replies.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
replies.body: Be respectul to others and follow reddits guidelines and policies.

comments.author: Neragocoil
comments.body: Iterate. Play, and iterate again. Find out the small things you can improve and keep improving those, and play more. AI is a tool, but won't be able to create a decent game by itself. You need to supervise, monitor, and play a lot your game, that's what worked for me.
